purpose: Known official submission blockers plus recurring community/reviewer failure patterns. Community items are diagnostic signals, not policy.

failure_modes.symptom: One or more readOnlyHint/openWorldHint/destructiveHint values are missing or null.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: Every model-visible tool must set all three to explicit booleans.
failure_modes.remediation: Infer from actual implementation behavior, set explicitly, and add written justification.

failure_modes.symptom: Review says annotations do not match tool behavior.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: Cross-check declared annotations against mutation, external access, and irreversibility behavior flags plus source scan.
failure_modes.remediation: Fix annotation or behavior; never tune annotations merely to look safer.

failure_modes.deterministic_check: Non-empty justification for readOnly/openWorld/destructive on every tool.
failure_modes.remediation: Explain each flag in terms of actual side effects and external access.

failure_modes.symptom: Developer name differs from verified individual/business identity.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: Verify publisher identity and public URLs all use matching legal/publisher identity.
failure_modes.remediation: Use the verified individual/business name or complete business verification before submitting.

failure_modes.symptom: Reviewer cannot sign in despite developer-mode success.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: Fresh-incognito review account succeeds with zero MFA, SMS, email confirmation, invitation, private network, or manual setup.
failure_modes.remediation: Create dedicated reviewer account and rehearse exact flow outside your normal session.

failure_modes.deterministic_check: Current successful tool scan immediately before final submission.
failure_modes.remediation: Rescan after every tool/schema/metadata deployment and only submit current production endpoint.

failure_modes.symptom: Remote MCP domain is not verified.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: Complete OpenAI challenge at /.well-known/openai-apps-challenge for the submitted domain.
failure_modes.remediation: Serve exact challenge and re-run verification before final submit.

failure_modes.symptom: Submitted test cases do not reliably reproduce expected tool choice/output on web/mobile.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: Run all five positives and three negatives repeatedly against production and validate expected tool + essential output invariants.
failure_modes.remediation: Make tools/output deterministic where possible, reduce ambiguous prompts, fix timeouts/schema drift, and retest web/mobile.

failure_modes.symptom: Wrong/no tool is chosen or reviewers reject unclear tool descriptions.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: Description states what, when-to-use, when-not-to-use/distinction, and important prerequisites/limits; evaluate positive/negative routing suite.
failure_modes.remediation: Generate candidate descriptions with the target model and hill-climb against routing evals.

failure_modes.symptom: Model hesitates between near-duplicate provider/API-shaped tools.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: Pairwise semantic overlap review; flag internal-provider-shaped names and >6 public tools as heuristic.
failure_modes.remediation: Expose user-intent tools; keep provider operations private behind adapters.

failure_modes.symptom: structuredContent does not match declared outputSchema or outputs vary unexpectedly.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: Schema-validate every structured response in CI and integration tests.
failure_modes.remediation: Version schema deliberately and return exact structured object with stable identifiers.

failure_modes.symptom: Plugin primarily proxies/scrapes another third-party service without authorized relationship or independent value.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: Every third-party integration must document authorization, official API/partner access, ToS review, and whether product is primarily pass-through.
failure_modes.remediation: Use authorized APIs/partnerships and add genuine independent normalization/ranking/workflow utility; if product remains primarily an unofficial connector, do not submit.

failure_modes.deterministic_check: No wildcard connect/resource/frame domains; every domain justified by actual app behavior.
failure_modes.remediation: Narrow CSP to exact required origins.

failure_modes.symptom: iframe/frameDomains usage triggers stricter review or rejection.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: If frameDomains non-empty, require written necessity and exact domain allowlist.
failure_modes.remediation: Prefer native Apps SDK widget/tool flow; use frames only when essential.

failure_modes.symptom: Tool asks for raw conversation history, precise location, credentials, restricted or irrelevant personal data.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: Static field-name scan + manual purpose/necessity review.
failure_modes.remediation: Request only task-specific minimums; use host/location side channels; never collect prohibited restricted data.

failure_modes.symptom: Plugin tries to transact prohibited digital goods/services/subscriptions or embeds ads.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: commerce enum and payment flows must conform to current physical-goods rules; serves_ads=false.
failure_modes.remediation: Move unsupported commerce out of plugin or wait for policy/platform support.

failure_modes.symptom: Team treats approval as automatic meaningful traffic.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: Launch plan includes owned/partner distribution and invocation evals independent of directory traffic.
failure_modes.remediation: Use literal app name/subtitle, validate direct invocation, and treat directory surfacing as upside not CAC model.

failure_modes.symptom: Long review cycle causes requirements/platform behavior to change between submission and decision.
failure_modes.deterministic_check: Core backend/MCP deploys independently of store review; stable public tool contracts; preflight against current docs immediately before every submission/update.
failure_modes.remediation: Keep store surface thin and rerun canonical checks on submission day.
